pages_read.title: Bulgaria Discovers Massive Government Breach After Five Years of Undetected Spying

notes: Security Affairs (23 Nov) relays Reuters and BTA: same 130 GB / 62 million pages, since 2021, several international groups, no country linked, access blocked and malware removed, no evidence personal data affected, detected in August by the new monitoring system. Its only extras (document types, responding agencies, the minister asking prosecutors to examine the missed detection) are relayed from Reuters with commentary and add nothing a defender needs. The article wrongly calls BTA a cybersecurity agency.
